problem: inactive→active reports `return`: a second `sessionStarted` without `sessionEnded`, an extra resume and sync.
The wordTabs branch drops page scroll also for the red Self-check Word of the Day card (not a fixed frame): a tall card is cut off.
fix: Keep `PagerScrollView` for cards that are not a fixed frame.

problem: A failed read only logs; the screen stays loading forever.
fix: Use `useCompositionRead` and its failed state (see R77).

problem: After `await silence()` there is no `latestTap !== tap` check (the recording path has it at :128): two fast taps both speak.
`await recordingOf(id)` is uncaught; a rejection escapes through `void pronunciation.toggle`.
fix: try/catch and fall back to the device voice.

problem: Stored `line` is not keyed by `entryId`: a new Entry shows the old Entry's counters until its read lands.
fix: Store `{entryId, line}` and return it only on a match.

problem: The Dashboard date is read with `todayDate(deviceClock)` at render; after midnight the header may show yesterday (a day-turn re-render probably hides it).
fix: Take `today` from a subscribed source, as `useFeed` does.

problem: Every launch copies the whole bundled SQLite pack (`forceOverwrite`) just to read its version; `replaceWithBundled` copies again.
fix: Ship the bundled content version as config.

problem: Hand-rolled `{in: composition}` + `active` read in 5 hooks.
`PlayingLemma` and `useSampleReading` carry the same two effects.
Grid model (`sizeOf`, `isBlock`, `answerAt`) is Core logic living in the app; `crossingCells` is O(cells×words×letters) on each render.
fix: Move it to packages/core and index cells once in a Map.

problem: Module has no importer; only commented-out uses remain.
fix: Delete the module and the commented lines.

problem: `parsed as Partial<...>` cast and hand-written JSON parse at the storage edge.
`update` merges onto render-time `current`: two updates in one event lose the first.
`canDismiss()` guards `back()`: check and action differ.
`useLocalSearchParams<{x: string}>` unchecked in 7 routes (only correction-type parses).
fix: Parse params once at the route edge.

problem: Inline `subscribe` to `useSyncExternalStore` resubscribes and re-arms the timer each render.
`useShown()` (32 callers) evaluates all switch checks and returns a new object per render.
`cards` map and filters rebuilt each render, new list `data`.
`reopenForSwitches` exists (:76) but :119 and background-sync repeat its reopen + Widget Snapshot body.
Next-local-day timer written twice.
`useCategories`/`useCorrectionCategories` differ only by kind; the two category routes too.
`sourceTab`/`tipExceptions` threaded by hand through 3 screens and 3 `SwipedEntryCard` branches.
`relative` / `RelativeText` used only by its test. (Commented DESIGN-05 code nearby is deliberate.)
